title: About 5 months into copy trading and my account is in profit so far
author: position_log
selftext:
Been trying a copy trading setup for about 5 months now, and honestly it has gone better than I expected.

I started with a smaller test amount first just to see how the trader handled real market conditions. After watching it for a bit, I added more once I felt more comfortable with how the trades were being managed.

So far, my own account is in profit. What made me continue was not just the win rate, it was the overall numbers:

* controlled drawdown
* strong profit factor
* losing trades still managed properly
* weekly and monthly results stayed positive so far
* less emotional than trying to trade manually myself

A high win rate by itself does not really tell the full story, so I wanted to see how it handled losses too, not just the winning trades.

There is still real risk, so I am not treating it like guaranteed income. But after about 5 months, I can see why some people prefer this over manual trading.

Anyone here had a genuine long-term experience with copy trading? What numbers do you usually look at besides win rate?
